metadata.description: Acceptance-test-driven development for Claude Code, with a record a reviewer can check.

plugins.name: compass
plugins.description: Compass lets a team under change control hand code changes to an AI agent and still show a reviewer, or an auditor, that the process was followed. The agent writes the acceptance tests, Compass proves they fail without the change and pass with it, and each change leaves a trail.md of who asked, what was agreed, the failing and passing runs, who approved and what shipped, with a SHA-256 digest for each record that a reviewer checks without Compass installed.
